status: New protocol fixed before its outcomes; preserve all original anchored studies
family: f_q=q S zeta, zeta=(h(phi)*observed_rate,h(phi)*x,-u), h=(1,cos,sin); all seven entries of q adapt on the unit sphere; no boxes, fixed coefficient, ridge, or derivative targets
observation: Backward complete-feature secant over0.05s, scaled by S; includes held-input jumps, not instantaneous raw-context tangent. Clean endpoint features satisfy the same true homogeneous relation; an ordinary smooth-path FTC is not presumed across jumps
law: Rdot=w*w^T-R/8, qdot=-gain*(q*R-(q*R*q^T)*q); held latest measured secant on each0.01s interval, R initially zero
integration: Exact analytic R(s), scipy DOP853 for ydot=-gain*R(s)*y, starting from current unit q; q_next=y(dt)/norm(y(dt)); this is numerical integration of the coupled normalized law, not a frozen-covariance exponential
gain_choice: gain1 fixed without outcome tuning; R uses unnormalized exponential integral as in the paper
primary: Replay all ten saved PG-controller observation streams from the separately identified estimator comparison; normalized flow, exact bottom-eigenvector estimator and frozen normalized prior see identical observations
secondary: All ten seeds use normalized-flow control of their own plant; bottom-eigenvector and frozen-prior estimators remain same-stream shadows, not independent controllers
eigen_estimator: Unit bottom eigenvector of exactly the same R; numerical ties include eigenvalues within1e-12*max(1,lambda_max) of minimum; project previous vector into tied space, or project deterministic largest-diagonal coordinate if orthogonal; orient consistently
readout: u=(rho_q*(desired_rate-2*(x-desired))+kappa_q*x)/q6; calibrated zero residual level as original; if abs(q6)<0.05, use original initial physical coefficients for that command and record guard activation; do not alter the normalized learner
rank: abs(q6) is a phase-uniform lower bound on unscaled evaluated Jacobian norm at each recorded coefficient; sampled inactive guard does not by itself certify every between-sample coefficient
unchanged_plant: Original Fourier plant truth, phase_rate4, reference, initial_state0.2, Gaussian rate-noise sd0.001, RK4 held input, no input saturation
timing: Command with pre-update q, sense current noisy rate, score pre-update q, assimilate held secant and integrate learning over next interval, advance plant with held command; final sample is scored but not assimilated
metrics: physical differential error after learned-input gauge alignment
tracking RMSE and control RMS on own trajectory only
validation: coupled-law integration checked against direct normalized ODE
rebuild every memory and pre-update score from raw observations
independent selected transition checks and tighter-tolerance full seed10 replay
all ten seeds, failures and any unfavorable outcomes retained
scope: Known harmonic integrable family, exact state/input/clock, noisy rate, calibrated residual level; does not establish physical excitation from noisy covariance, general stability, or matching mechanisms in contact and Burgers
compute: One sequential process; fixed protocol and source snapshots; never overwrite existing output directory
